scenes: Why are some streets so much hotter than others?
Trees and parks cluster in better-off neighbourhoods, | which can pay for them, and for the upkeep that keeps them alive.
In Jakarta, dense low-income neighbourhoods act as heat islands, | while green space is concentrated in wealthier areas.
Start the shade where the heat is worst, | and plant it in a way that doesn’t push people out.
